words.def: the opinion someone forms of you the moment they meet you
words.ex: She made a great {first impression} at the conference.

words.def: to contact someone again after a first meeting
words.ex: He sent an email to {follow up} after the event.

words.def: truly meaning what you say, without pretending
words.ex: A {sincere} compliment builds far more trust than an empty one.

words.def: to stay in regular contact with someone
words.ex: We met at a conference and have {kept in touch} ever since.

words.def: light, friendly conversation about everyday topics
words.ex: Good {small talk} is an important skill at networking events.

words.def: to expand into new areas or groups beyond your usual circle
words.ex: Cross-industry events helped her {diversify} her professional network.

words.def: a chance to do something useful or beneficial
words.ex: Networking can open up great career {opportunities}.

words.def: by taking action before something is needed, rather than waiting
words.ex: She {proactively} reached out to people in her field.
